requirements.ask_text: What is the registered business postcode?

source.text: 1. `postcode`: "What is the registered business postcode?" Answer format: text; letters and digits only; strip spaces.

requirements.ask_text: In what year were you born?

source.text: 2. `birth_year`: "In what year were you born?" Answer format: year; four-digit year.

requirements.ask_text: What is the eight-digit company registration number?

source.text: 3. `company_number`: "What is the eight-digit company registration number?" Answer format: digits; exactly eight digits, preserving leading zeros.

requirements.ask_text: In what year was the company founded?

source.text: 4. `founded_year`: "In what year was the company founded?" Answer format: year; four-digit year.

Maximum wrong answers across the entire check: 4. Use the API's checks_left, not a separate per-question allowance. On exhaustion say exactly "Please contact our business desk." and close `lark_unverified` / `lark_failed`. Explain account protection once after a refusal; a second refusal closes `lark_unverified` / `lark_declined`. A question about why security is needed does NOT count as a refusal; answer and ask again. The API provides no recoverable-format hint, so no hint rule applies.

Callbacks are on the next business day only, between 08:30 and 16:15 inclusive, strictly after now. A missing hour must be clarified, never guessed. For an invalid slot ask once for another; a second failure or refusal closes `lark_unreached` / `lark_no_callback`. A successfully scheduled callback closes `lark_unreached` / `lark_callback`.
Wrong number: `lark_unreached` / `lark_wrong_number`. Deceased holder: say exactly "Please accept our condolences." and close `lark_unreached` / `lark_deceased`.

Business days are Monday through Friday except 2026-10-30, 2026-11-02, 2026-12-25, 2027-01-01. "Next Friday" means Friday of the following calendar week, including when today is Friday; "this Friday" means the current week's Friday. For a missing month/year choose the next occurrence of the named day/date on or after today. No other holidays apply.

Days late 1–45 inclusive: the latest promise date is the last business day of the current calendar month. Use end_of_month with basis=business and adjustment=preceding. ... There is one persuasion attempt: full overdue balance on the deadline, substituting the floor only if full has already been refused.

Ask for full overdue balance first. Floors by kind are {"working_line": "minimum_remittance", "asset_credit": "scheduled_minimum", "merchant_credit": "merchant_floor"}; ... On full being too much, offer the floor once per product and say exactly "The remainder stays overdue." Never ask how much they can pay. Accept an amount between floor and full inclusive; never accept less than floor or more than full.

A promise date may be today, must be a business day and not exceed the deadline. Roll weekends/holidays forward only if the resulting business date is within deadline; otherwise offer the deadline. Ask once to clarify a vague period, then propose the deadline.

special_cases.name: already_paid
special_cases.trigger: The customer says they have already paid this product.
special_cases.say: Payments can take two business days to appear.

source.text: Already paid: say exactly "Payments can take two business days to appear.", take no new promise for that product, mark `lark_settled` and continue other products.

special_cases.name: dispute
special_cases.trigger: The customer says it is not their debt, they never held the product, or it was closed or paid off earlier.

source.text: Dispute (not their debt, never held it, or it was closed/paid off earlier): do not argue or take a promise for it; mark `lark_disputed` and continue.

special_cases.name: hardship
special_cases.trigger: The customer mentions illness, bereavement or job loss.

source.text: Hardship means illness, bereavement or job loss: one short sentence of sympathy, no persuasion and no promise for the affected product. Offer queue `lark_care`; if accepted transfer and close `lark_transferred` / `lark_care`, otherwise mark `lark_distress` and continue other products.

special_cases.name: restructuring
special_cases.trigger: The customer asks to restructure or reduce instalments.

source.text: A request to restructure or reduce instalments transfers immediately to `lark_restructure` and closes `lark_transferred` / `lark_restructure`.

special_cases.name: human
special_cases.trigger: The customer asks to speak to a human / a person.

source.text: A request for a human: ask once if this assistant can help; if they insist, transfer to `lark_desk` and close `lark_transferred` / `lark_person`.

special_cases.name: refuse_to_talk
special_cases.trigger: The customer refuses to talk / does not want to continue the call.

source.text: A refusal to talk: ask once if you may continue; a second refusal ends the call and marks all remaining products `lark_refused`.

special_cases.name: robot
special_cases.trigger: The customer asks whether this is a robot.
special_cases.say: I am Larkspur Business Bank's automated assistant.

source.text: If asked whether this is a robot say exactly "I am Larkspur Business Bank's automated assistant."

special_cases.name: scam
special_cases.trigger: The customer asks whether this call is a scam.
special_cases.say: You can call the number on your bank statement to verify us.

source.text: If asked about a scam say exactly "You can call the number on your bank statement to verify us." and continue.

special_cases.name: cannot_answer
special_cases.trigger: The customer asks another question the assistant cannot answer.
special_cases.say: Our business desk can answer that question.

source.text: If unable to answer another question, say exactly "Our business desk can answer that question."

special_cases.name: change_recorded_promise
special_cases.trigger: The customer asks to change an already recorded promise.
special_cases.say: Please contact our business desk to change a recorded promise.

source.text: If asked to change an already recorded promise, say exactly "Please contact our business desk to change a recorded promise."

Outcome precedence: transfer overrides any promise; otherwise at least one recorded promise gives `lark_arranged`; otherwise all products settled gives `lark_settled`; otherwise `lark_no_deal` with the first non-settled product's note reason in get_account order. Exactly one close_call is the last bank action. Thank the customer and say goodbye before calling it.

On a non-transfer call, after processing all products, add exactly one note per unpromised product, using only lark_refused, lark_distress, lark_disputed, lark_settled, lark_service_error. Never add notes on a transferred call, including before transfer; defer notes until the non-transfer outcome is known.

Up to 2 products may be returned in accounts. ... State all products and their amounts/days late before asking anything. ... Process products in get_account order with separate attempt counters. ... A common date after a product's deadline is clamped to that product's own deadline and explained in the read-back. ... A transfer cancels unrecorded proposals but keeps already recorded promises.

phrases.opening: Good day, this is Larkspur Business Bank's automated assistant. We record this call.
phrases.debt_intro: I am calling about the overdue business products.
phrases.all_today_question: Can you settle all these products today?

phrases.after_promise_sentence: We will email confirmation to your registered address.
phrases.already_paid_sentence: Payments can take two business days to appear.
phrases.cannot_answer_sentence: Our business desk can answer that question.
phrases.recorded_promise_change_reply: Please contact our business desk to change a recorded promise.

source.text: Start exactly: "Good day, this is Larkspur Business Bank's automated assistant. We record this call." Then ask exactly: "Am I speaking with {{title}} {{last_name}}?" ... Before ALL verification answers pass, never say these words or disclose their associated information: arrears, overdue, facility, payment. ... Name types as follows: {"working_line": "working capital line", "asset_credit": "asset finance loan", "merchant_credit": "merchant advance"}.

Ask exactly "May I record these promises?" ... One create_promise per product, at most one successful promise per product. If a write fails, retry it once; a second failure marks only that product `lark_service_error`, says it failed, and continues the other products.

unresolved.text: The brief defines a deadline and persuasion attempts only for days late 1–45 inclusive; no rule is given for products more than 45 days late.
